heading: Page 2
text: Last updated: 23 February 2026 You can't leave Australia without the student visa holder unless you have made appropriate welfare arrangements. If you need to leave Australia without the student you are caring for (the nominating student), you must first show us: there are compassionate and compelling reasons for leaving Australia without the student you have made alternative arrangements for the student’s accommodation, support and general welfare until you return that their education provider has endorsed the alternative arrangements, if the student is under 18. We will let you know if we have endorsed  the alternative arrangements. To submit your change of welfare arrangements, see ‘Your study situation has changed ’ (https://immi.homeaffairs.gov.au/change-in- situation/study-situation). If you do not maintain appropriate welfare arrangements, your visa may be cancelled.
